        Config can be generated for any device. By default, all traffic goes through the tunnel. Route and DNS presets can be configured in the modal window via the ⚙ button next to the generate buttons.

        What is this?

        The generator creates a ready AmneziaWG/WARP profile for import into a VPN client. You can download a .conf file or copy vpn:// if your client supports quick import. Full tunnel routes all supported traffic through WARP, while split tunnel routes only selected destinations. Connectivity depends on the client, network, endpoint, DNS, and routes.

        The generator reduces manual configuration, but it does not guarantee connectivity in every network or client.

        Installation & Setup Guide

        1. Download and install AmneziaWG:
          Follow the download link and get the installer for Windows. Install to the default path "C:\Program Files\...".
        2. Generate and import the config file:
          Choose AWG 1.5, 2.0, 3.0, or 3.1 according to client support. AWG 3.x uses a WARP-safe client profile; AWG 3.1 is recommended with AmneziaVPN 5.0.1.5+ or a compatible client. Download the configuration and import the .conf file into the client.

        After importing, enable the tunnel in the client. The client restores its state when Windows starts.

        What to check if it does not work

        • If it does not connect: check endpoint, port, UDP availability, AWG mode, and client version.
        • If it connects but websites do not open: check DNS, AllowedIPs, IPv6, and MTU.
        • If it works on Wi-Fi but not on mobile network: try another port, hostname instead of IP, or another endpoint mode.
        • If import fails: check the AWG mode, client parser version, profile format, and import method. AWG 3.0 vpn:// is intentionally unavailable.

        Additional Information

        🌐 Routes and AllowedIPs

        By default, all traffic goes through the tunnel (AllowedIPs = 0.0.0.0/0, ::/0). In settings (⚙ button) you can choose a DNS server and presets — only the required IPv4 subnets will be routed through the tunnel. IPv6 can be enabled optionally, but it increases the route count 2–3× and may cause issues on routers and mobile clients. Safe limit — 1000 IPv4 CIDR.

        IP ranges can be replaced manually. Up-to-date lists at opencck.org and rockblack.pro.

        ℹ AWG versions and Cloudflare WARP

        AWG 1.5 (Legacy)
        • Static obfuscation parameters (Jc, S1–S4, H1–H4)
        • Masks only the start of the connection
        • Works with Cloudflare WARP without a server
        • Compatible with older clients
        AWG 2.0
        • Dynamic headers + random padding in all packets
        • Mimics QUIC/DNS throughout the entire session
        • Harder to detect with heuristic DPI analysis
        • Requires client ≥ 4.8.12.9 (Amnezia)

        ⚠ Is a server required for AWG 2.0?

        For Cloudflare WARP — no. Configs from this generator work with Cloudflare's public server without any server-side configuration.

        For your own server — yes. Self-hosted AWG 2.0 requires an updated kernel/module amneziawg-linux-kernel-module on the server and new client configs (old AWG 1.5 configs become incompatible). See the official documentation for details.
